evidence: 2026-09-30: real signup through the Agent Vault proxy using this recipe (vault-minted password), with browser egress through the owner's tunnel on a US network. All five selectors matched; the birth month and day selects were set and the phone filled; the first submit opened the 6-digit emailed-code dialog. The account owner entered the code and clicked Create Account in a handoff (outcome completed); no error was shown, and two account emails from Macy's arrived at the signup address within a minute. A second signup with the same email was then answered that an account already exists. A fresh sign-in through the proxy did not get past the sign-in form, which reported the email as not valid (see gotchas). On 2026-09-29, from the proxy's own egress, the final create answered "Something went wrong" every time.
gotchas: Password: at most 16 characters (the field's maxlength), and the page rejects spaces and . , - | \ / = _ (its own message); mint with a symbol set that excludes those.

Birth month, birth day and phone number are required; a submit without the phone marks it invalid. Birth month (#month) and day (#day) are native selects: choose an option rather than typing into them.
The email-offers box is ticked by default.
The submit button's label varies between Continue and Create Account; its id (#ca-profile-submit) is stable.
After submit, a dialog asks for a 6-digit code sent by email, in six one-digit boxes (autocomplete=one-time-code) with a Create Account button. The code belongs to the account owner: hand it off.
On 2026-09-29, from the Agent Vault proxy's own egress, Create Account answered "Something went wrong. Please refresh the page or try again later." From a US egress on 2026-09-30 it went through.

On 2026-09-30 the sign-in page (/account/signin) reported "valid email" for the same address the signup accepted (an address with a + tag), through two fresh page loads; sign-in was not completed through the proxy.
notes: Discovered by scripts/signup-selectors.ts (session arm); driven through the Agent Vault proxy on 2026-09-29 and 2026-09-30, see evidence.
